description: This file implements core tracing functionalities related to the TRACE2 framework in a Git-like project. It manages trace targets, event emission, timestamping, signal handling, process and thread events, command line activities, and data recording. It integrates with external trace targets and maintains internal state for enabling/disabling tracing features.
